items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday; Marcus Mariota will start vs Colts.
items.why: Elbow injury; not quite ready per coach Dan Quinn.
items.implication: Mariota starts again; impacts Commanders pass catchers volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Potential bump for Deebo Samuel, Terry McLaurin, others in short-term.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss at least four games.
items.why: Hamstring injury aggravated; coach Kellen Moore confirmed IR.
items.implication: Out minimum four weeks; next eligibility ~Nov 8.
items.opportunity: Lead backfield role opens for Alvin Kamara with Kendre Miller and others in committee.

items.text: Little optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; expectation he won’t go.
items.why: Hamstring sidelined this week; sources indicate won't play.
items.implication: Rams get Nacua back as Eagles short a top WR.
items.opportunity: Boost for A.J. Brown targets and secondary options like Dontayvion Wicks.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers upgraded to full participants on Thursday injury report.
items.why: Clearest signal both cleared hamstring/prior issues for Week 4.
items.implication: Both expected to play without limitation; Ravens offense intact.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share restored for Flowers; Jackson dual-threat back.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (TNF vs CLE): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage on short week; matchup favorable vs Browns run D.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; volume secure with Dowdle out again.
items.opportunity: Near-every-down role + receiving; high floor/ceiling TNF.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (@ NO): 35%+ career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite chemistry/volume with Michael Penix Jr. back; soft WR TD matchup.
items.implication: WR1 upside locked in with QB stability.
items.opportunity: High target share + yards; red-zone potential vs Saints.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles after limited practice progress.
items.why: Good workout/walkthrough; limited then progressing; no IR consideration.
items.implication: Elite WR1 if active; monitor full practices for workload confidence.
items.opportunity: Restores high target share/YPRR; may temper Davante Adams volume slightly.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS Top-150: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall (notable high); also Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30.
items.why: Updated for injuries/roles/schedule; Walker near top of board.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold ROS; trade calculator updated accordingly.

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert (@ SEA): 44% pressure rate season; SEA 4th in pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC allowed; bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: High pressure environment vs elite SEA pass rush/coverage; low team total.
items.implication: Avoid as QB1; tough efficiency spot.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (@ SEA): RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3 (13% 3rd down); SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Declining role/usage + brutal run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts (@ NO): Just 16% target share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9/13 Penix games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Historically low involvement when Penix starts; underperformance.
items.conflict: Levitan also flags low targets/aDOT/no RZ.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson (@ CHI, Mitchell likely out, 36% share prior), Josh Downs (vs WSH, 31% share/43% RZ, WAS worst vs WRs/slot), George Kittle (vs DEN, rising share, Evans day-to-day, DEN soft vs TEs).
items.why: Elevated target shares + favorable matchups/usage trends.
items.implication: Strong WR2/TE1 starts with clear opportunity.
items.opportunity: Wilson/Downs high target %; Kittle routes climbing + TE matchup.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.why: Eligible and activated for practice window.
items.implication: Could return soon; monitor for SEA RB committee changes.
items.opportunity: Potential handcuff/backup role expansion or competition.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among biggest underperformers relative to opportunity.
items.why: Minimal targets, zero RZ looks, inefficient aDOT vs actual opportunity chart.
items.implication: Sell/low confidence TE; London dominating share with Penix.
